messages:
Alex Chen: heads up — big docs refactor split into 6 PRs just opened. moving /guides -> /docs/guides and renaming a bunch of anchors. will need reviewers and a merge plan.
Priya Singh: thanks alex. can you paste the list of PR numbers and which ones are safe to merge first?
Alex Chen: sure — PRs: #5123 (top-level index + redirects), #5124 (guides move), #5125 (sdk snippets), #5126 (migration guide), #5127 (anchors fix), #5128 (redirect mapping). my suggested order: 5123 -> 5128 -> 5124 -> 5127 -> 5125 -> 5126
Jamie Ortiz: why 5128 before 5124?
Alex Chen: 5128 contains the redirect table used by the CDN and netlify redirects. if we move files before updating redirects previews will 404. keep redirects in place first.
Maria Lopez: CI note — our docs preview job is flaky when too many preview deploys run. can we stagger merges by ~20m so previews stabilize?
Priya Singh: yes please. also CODEOWNERS will need updating for the new paths. who owns the new /docs/guides area?
Ken Wu: I can update CODEOWNERS in #5123. I'll add @Priya and @Jamie as reviewers. also add @docs-bot in reviewers so it runs the link-check.
Alex Chen: perfect. also request from product: don't merge any of these during the release candidate window next Tue 14:00-18:00 UTC.
Jamie Ortiz: cc: @sre-bot — can you flag if a merge triggers preview deploys exceeding quota?
sre-bot: automatically monitoring preview-deploy queue. will post if >6 active previews.
docs-bot: running link-checker on PR 5123 now. found 4 external dead links and 2 broken anchors in moved files.
Priya Singh: broken anchors are the biggest risk. we should include a compatibility redirect for old anchors (anchor tombstones) and a small script to rewrite old fragment links.
Alex Chen: created a small mapping file: /scripts/anchor-redirects.json and added it in #5128. snippet:
```
{
  "old-anchor-name": "new-anchor-name",
  "legacy-section-1": "guides/legacy#section-1"
}
```
Maria Lopez: QA: once #5128 is merged, can you run the preview smoke test? checklist: open 10 high-traffic docs pages, click saved TOC links, validate redirects and anchors.
Jamie Ortiz: I'll do the smoke test. suggest we do a canary merge to the staging site first (merge 5123 -> staging, validate, then 5128 -> staging). if green, proceed to main but stagger.
Priya Singh: reviewers: @Jamie, @Priya on 5123, 5128. @Ken to handle CODEOWNERS in 5123. @Maria will run smoke tests from staging links. add me as final approver for 5124 and 5127.
Alex Chen: note on cherry-picks: if a content-only fix is needed post-merge, create a small PR that targets the new path and include `cherry-pick-to: main` in the body.
Ken Wu: CI tip — use `./scripts/preview-keepalive.sh` to avoid netlify timing out when previews hang. but only run it in case of >10m deploy times.
Maria Lopez: found one case where an old anchor in a blog post pointed to `#getting-started-v1` — that'll 404 after the rename. we should add anchor redirect for that blog slug as well.
Alex Chen: added blog slug entries to #5128. also added a metadata flag to preserve old slugs: `legacy_slugs: true`.
docs-bot: anchor-check complete for PRs 5123-5128. summary: 7 anchors remapped, 3 external links updated, 1 missing image (in migration guide).
Priya Singh: migration guide (#5126) has that missing image — hold merging 5126 until image is fixed or replaced.
Jamie Ortiz: proposed merge windows tomorrow: 10:00-11:30 UTC (batch 1: 5123, 5128), 14:00-15:00 UTC (batch 2: 5124, 5127), 16:30-17:00 UTC (batch 3: 5125). avoid 18:00-20:00 UTC (release prep).
Alex Chen: I'm OK with that. I'll coordinate and post merge checklist in each PR:
- confirm netlify preview URL in PR
- run smoke test checklist
- confirm CODEOWNERS updated
- add `merge-window: <time>` label
Jamie Ortiz: I'll add `needs-smoke` and `canary-approved` labels as I test staging.
Ken Wu: small heads-up: the staging site's search index will need reindexing after the move. I'll kick off reindex after batch 2 completes: `./tools/reindex-docs --staging`.
Maria Lopez: if we see any anchor fallout in production, we should have a quick rollback plan: revert #5123 and #5128 together. do we have an automated revert plan?
Alex Chen: yes — I'll prepare revert PRs in advance and mark them `revert-prep` so we can hit merge quickly.
docs-bot: created preview links:
- PR 5123 preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.com/pr-5123
- PR 5128 preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.com/pr-5128
- PR 5124 preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.com/pr-5124
Jamie Ortiz: started smoke test on 5123 preview. initial pass: redirects ok, search results showing old-to-new slugs as expected. :thumbsup:
Maria Lopez: found one anchor mismatch on 5124 preview (TOC link jumps to wrong heading). looks like an extra h2 got introduced during the move.
Alex Chen: I can patch that in 5127 (anchors fix). please retest after 5127 is merged to staging.
Priya Singh: to speed reviews, I'm ok with approving 5123 and 5128 now if Jamie signs off on staging. will hold 5124/5127 until anchor patch validated.
Jamie Ortiz: staging canary for 5123+5128 green. I approve those two. merging in first window at 10:05 UTC.
Ken Wu: leaving CODEOWNERS update in #5123 — after merge, please update any PATHS in automation that rely on old locations (deploy hooks, backfills).
Alex Chen: merging notes: watch preview logs for 2m after merge; if netlify deploy fails, immediate revert. will post status here.
sre-bot: monitoring deploy — 5123 and 5128 deploys triggered, previews building (2 active previews).
docs-bot: post-merge link-check: 5123/5128 live. no regressions found in checked pages. :party_parrot:
Maria Lopez: batch 1 merged successfully. I'll run the extended smoke run now.
Jamie Ortiz: planning next steps: fix anchor in 5127, then re-run preview, then merge 5124/5127 in window 14:00-15:00 UTC. everyone ok?
Priya Singh: yes. thanks all — great coordination. I'll update the PR descriptions with the merge schedule and add labels.
Alex Chen: thanks team. I'll follow up with the revert PRs and a short playbook in the repo: `docs/OPERATIONS/merge-refactor-playbook.md`.
Maria Lopez: saved checklist: `smoke.md` linked in playbook. assigning follow-ups in the PRs.
Ken Wu: if anyone hits anchor edge cases, drop them in this thread and tag @Ken.
Alex Chen: closing loop — will post a short summary after the final batch.
Jamie Ortiz: nice work — smooth for a huge diff. :tada:
